title: Hindi TRAI SIM-block scam
description: Romanised Hindi: TRAI SIM block, crime branch transfer, secrecy, OTP and transfer ask.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Namaste, main TRAI se bol raha hoon. Aapka SIM do ghante mein block ho jayega.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke Aadhaar se ek aur SIM liya gaya hai jo illegal activities mein use ho raha hai. Main aapko Delhi crime branch se connect kar raha hoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Main Delhi crime branch se Inspector Yadav bol raha hoon. Aapke naam par money laundering ka case hai. Kisi ko bhi mat batana, ghar walon ko bhi nahi.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Agar cooperate nahi kiya to aapko abhi giraftaar kiya jayega.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Verification ke liye apna saara paisa is account mein transfer kar dijiye, sab refund ho jayega. Aur jo OTP aaya hai woh bata dijiye.
